about_the_game:
"I'm a Frog" - A Story of Challenge and Growth

“Only those who dare to fail greatly can ever achieve greatly.” — Robert F. Kennedy

"I'm a Frog" is a powerful tale of growth through failure. The protagonist, a tadpole born in a well, dreams of escaping the confining walls of the narrow space. However, the other frogs guarding the well relentlessly block the protagonist’s every attempt, forcing them to face constant failure.

But failure is not the end. With each setback, the protagonist grows stronger, and the desire for freedom becomes even more intense. Each failure brings new abilities, and the protagonist becomes faster, more powerful, and better equipped to face the challenges ahead.

"I'm a Frog" reminds players that true achievement comes to those who persist through failure. The protagonist’s journey to escape the well is more than just a game; it carries a message that growth comes from the willingness to try, to fail, and to try again.

Don’t fear failure—embrace it, and keep challenging yourself. Success awaits those who never give up.

Controls

  • Z – Special Attack

  • X – Jump

  • C – Attack

  • Arrow Keys – Move

  • ESC – Exit
